en.intro: Backend developer (Go/Python) who builds LLM-powered tools. Ledger integrations on Canton prove the distributed-systems side, and every tool ships with CI and tests.
en.aboutText: I am a software engineer: a backend developer in Go and Python who builds LLM-powered tools: at DEKRA, a measurement-review tool with deterministic rules and an on-premise LLM, now in production at the lab. Integrating with the Canton ledger in Go is where I learned distributed systems.
